focusRingNotes.control: Orange focus ring (Contact me, Adjust my selections, Start my demo)
focusRingNotes.detail: Two-layer box-shadow: inner rgb(255,160,124) = 1.99:1 vs white (fails alone); outer rgb(224,94,52) = 3.61:1 vs white (passes). Combined likely adequate — Design should confirm intentional.
rgba(111,111,111,0.5) on rgba(0,0,0,0.35) bar over video: 1.34:1 (light frame) / 1.76:1 (dark frame) — fails 3:1 non-text focus-indicator requirement. Ring exists but is not reliably visible.
